title: Output of notes-entretien: what the user's last message changes in the notes sheet

analyse.description: (French) One or two sentences: what the user just taught the sheet (or « rien de nouveau »). Written BEFORE the modifications: it helps you forget nothing.

fin.description: Did the user say, in ANY of their messages (not only the last), how the story ends or what one should feel on leaving? origine = "dit" with the quotation copied word for word from THEIR messages (their choice among proposals counts: quote their words); "delegue" if they leave the ending to the agent (quotation of their delegation); "aucune" otherwise (empty quotation). If the ending already appears in `arc`, it means it was said: find the message.

modifications.description: The only sections this message changes or completes, each in its complete form (a list is returned in full). Empty if nothing changes.

arc.description: (French) Two to four sentences: what the story tells and its tipping point.

genreTon.description: (French) Genre and tone, in one or two sentences.

nom.description: (French) The style named explicitly (animation 2D, live-action cinématographique…).

clause.description: (English) One or two sentences, added as is at the start of video descriptions AND of still-image prompts (characters, sets). It describes the RENDERING (medium, line, colours, light), never a framing, a movement or an action (« dynamic shots », « cinematic action » have no place on a character sheet).

promptImage.description: (English) Set by the application when the project is created, never by you: leave it out.

image.description: Set by the application (file name of the style picture): leave it out.

dureeEpisodeSecondes.description: Target duration of an episode, in seconds. The one the user said or validated: do not invent it silently (see `questionsOuvertes`).

rythme.description: General cadence of the episode: lent (contemplative, long plans), mesure, soutenu, rapide (lively montage, dense cuts) or variable (alternates by scene). It sets plan duration and cut density downstream.

univers.description: (French) If the project takes up a pre-existing work or universe: which, and how to respect it (names, appearances, rules). Absent for an original project.

episodes.description: One episode per entry. For a full text: the proposed and validated split.

resume.description: (French) What the episode tells, in a few sentences.

portee.description: (French) For a full text: the chapters or arc covered.

age.description: (French) Concrete apparent age: « adolescente, 15 ans », « homme d'une quarantaine d'années ». It drives the image AND the voice: never left to chance.

apparence.description: (French) What is SEEN: silhouette, face, hair, outfit, distinguishing marks. Visual only: no role, no voice, no action.

reconnaissable.description: (French) What makes them recognizable in one sentence.

gestuelle.description: (French) How the character moves or acts when that is what defines them (fighting style, trade, gait, tic). Empty if they have no marked gesture.

voix.description: (French) Expected vocal impression, if they speak: consistent with age. Empty otherwise.

statut.description: Supplied by the user, deduced by you, or uncertain (reconstruction).

continuite.description: (French) Continuity rules: traits that never disappear, palettes.

description.description: (French) The two moments that answer each other and what repeats.

cliche.description: (French) What models produce by default on this subject.

formulationPositive.description: (French) What is described instead: never a negation.

inventions.description: (French) Everything that was not in the input. Each line was validated by the user.

questionsOuvertes.description: (French) What remains uncertain. Never filled in silently.

sources.description: For each modified or confirmed section, where the information comes from: « dit » or « delegue » with the user's quotation, or « invente » if you assumed it.

citation.description: Passage copied word for word from a message of the USER (the shortest that suffices), in the user's language; "" if origine = invente.
